Iran-US talks in Doha focus on frozen assets and MoU implementation

Indirect talks between Iran and the United States took place in Doha, Qatar, focusing on the implementation of a memorandum of understanding (MoU) and the use of frozen Iranian assets. Iran's Deputy Foreign Minister stated that Tehran would use some of its frozen funds in Qatar to purchase necessary goods. The talks are part of ongoing diplomatic efforts concerning the region.
